name: Branch Name Convention Check
description: Validates that branch names follow naming conventions (feature/, fix/, hotfix/, chore/) when creating or switching branches
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Validate branch naming conventions
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
PATTERN=${CLAUDE_BRANCH_PATTERN:-'^(feature|fix|hotfix|chore|release|docs|test)/[a-z0-9._-]+$'}
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+(checkout\s+-b|switch\s+-c|branch)\s'; then
  BRANCH=$(echo "$COMMAND" | grep -oE '(checkout\s+-b|switch\s+-c|branch)\s+\S+' | awk '{print $NF}')
  if [[ -n "$BRANCH" ]] && [[ "$BRANCH" != "main" ]] && [[ "$BRANCH" != "master" ]] && [[ "$BRANCH" != "develop" ]]; then
    if ! echo "$BRANCH" | grep -qE "$PATTERN"; then
      echo "WARNING: Branch name '$BRANCH' does not follow naming conventions."
      echo "Expected pattern: feature/*, fix/*, hotfix/*, chore/*, release/*, docs/*, test/*"
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
